en: The image is a black-and-white photograph, likely from the early 20th century, depicting a man in a Napoleon Bonaparte costume (complete with epaulettes, medals, and hand-in-coat pose) standing in front of a backdrop decorated with Napoleonic symbols (large 'N's surrounded by laurel wreaths). Behind him, a woman in period costume is reclining on a couch, possibly styled as Josephine or another historical figure. The bottom left corner has the name 'Sarso - 30.' and at the bottom center is written 'U. Laakso. Napoleon och ...'.
